```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    required <- c("03_APriori", "04_TopDown", "05_Outputs")
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(candidate, required)))) {
      return(candidate)
    }
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) {
      stop("Could not locate the project root from ", start)
    }
    candidate <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
apriori_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "03_APriori", "SimsOutputs",
  "AUCinf_Percent_Extrapolated.csv"
)
topdown_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "04_TopDown", "SimsOutputs",
  "AUCinf_Percent_Extrapolated.csv"
)
output_csv <- file.path(
  project_root, "05_Outputs",
  "AUCinf_Percent_Extrapolated_Comparison.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(apriori_file)) stop("Missing ", apriori_file)
if (!file.exists(topdown_file)) stop("Missing ", topdown_file)

apriori <- read.csv(
  apriori_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)
topdown <- read.csv(
  topdown_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

key_columns <- c("Species", "Molecule", "Dose (mg/kg)")

check_unique_keys <- function(data, label) {
  duplicated_keys <- data %>%
    count(across(all_of(key_columns)), name = "rows_n") %>%
    filter(rows_n != 1L)
  if (nrow(duplicated_keys) > 0L) {
    stop(label, " contains duplicate molecule-dose keys.")
  }
}

check_unique_keys(apriori, "A priori results")
check_unique_keys(topdown, "TopDown results")

apriori_selected <- apriori %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Molecule,
    `Dose (mg/kg)`,
    `Observed (%)` =
      .data[["Observed AUC_extrapolated_mean_pct"]],
    `A priori predicted (%)` =
      .data[["Predicted AUC_extrapolated_mean_pct"]]
  )

topdown_selected <- topdown %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    Molecule,
    `Dose (mg/kg)`,
    `Observed from TopDown (%)` =
      .data[["Observed AUC_extrapolated_mean_pct"]],
    `Top-down predicted (%)` =
      .data[["Predicted AUC_extrapolated_mean_pct"]]
  )

comparison <- full_join(
  apriori_selected,
  topdown_selected,
  by = key_columns
)

if (nrow(comparison) != 44L) {
  stop("Expected 44 molecule-dose rows after joining; found ", nrow(comparison))
}

required_values <- c(
  "Observed (%)",
  "Observed from TopDown (%)",
  "A priori predicted (%)",
  "Top-down predicted (%)"
)
if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(comparison[required_values])))) {
  stop("The joined table contains missing or non-finite percentages.")
}

observed_difference <- abs(
  comparison[["Observed (%)"]] -
    comparison[["Observed from TopDown (%)"]]
)
if (any(observed_difference > 1e-9)) {
  stop(
    "Observed percentages do not match across approaches. Maximum difference: ",
    max(observed_difference)
  )
}

table_data <- comparison %>%
  select(
    Species,
    Molecule,
    `Dose (mg/kg)`,
    `Observed (%)`,
    `A priori predicted (%)`,
    `Top-down predicted (%)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(Species, levels = c("Monkey", "Human")),
    Molecule,
    `Dose (mg/kg)`
  )

write.csv(table_data, output_csv, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

format_extrapolation <- function(value) {
  label <- ifelse(
    value > 20,
    paste0(sprintf("%.1f", value), "\u2020"),
    sprintf("%.1f", value)
  )
  cell_spec(
    label,
    color = ifelse(value > 20, "#9C2F1C", "#1F2937"),
    background = ifelse(value > 20, "#FCE8E5", "transparent"),
    bold = value > 20
  )
}

display_table <- table_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      `Observed (%)`,
      `A priori predicted (%)`,
      `Top-down predicted (%)`
    ),
    format_extrapolation
  ))

display_table %>%
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    caption = paste(
      "Percentage of AUCinf extrapolated by species, molecule, and dose."
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = TRUE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "7em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "11em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "7em") %>%
  column_spec(4:6, width = "10em") %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "\u2020 Percentage of AUCinf extrapolated exceeds 20%.",
      "Observed values are calculated once from raw subject-level profiles;",
      "predicted values use the corresponding approach-specific profiles."
    ),
    general_title = ""
  )
```
